description.zh:
QoS策略五元组规则实例的描述。

长度为1~512个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The description of the quintuple rule instance in the QoS policy.

The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：**1**。
description.en: The page number. The default value is **1**.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页展示的五元组规则条目数。

默认值：**10**，最大值：**50**。
description.en:
The number of quintuple rules to return on each page.

The default value is **10**. The maximum value is **50**.

description.zh:
QoS策略五元组规则所属的限速规则的优先级。

优先级范围：**1~3**。数值越小，优先级越高。

> 如果您已经提交工单申请并通过[CreateQosPolicy](~~131575~~)创建了第4优先级的QoS策略，您可以通过本接口查询第4优先级的QoS策略五元组规则配置信息。
description.en:
The priority of the throttling rule to which the quintuple rule in the QoS policy belongs.

The priority range is 1 to **3**. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

> If you have submitted a ticket and created a priority-4 QoS policy by calling the [CreateQosPolicy](~~131575~~) operation, you can use this operation to query the configurations of quintuple rules for the priority-4 QoS policy.
The ID of the QoS policy instance.

description.zh: QoS策略五元组规则的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the quintuple rule instance in the QoS policy.
The ID of the region where the QoS policy instance resides.
